title: Legacy Page Modernization
prompt: Replace presentational markup such as font or center with semantic elements and CSS hooks.
objective: Show a before/after snippet and explain why the new structure is better.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: semantic conversion, accessibility.
hints: Preserve content and behavior while improving semantics. Validate after each small migration step.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Preserve content and behavior while improving semantics. Validate after each small migration step. Required structural evidence: <main>, <h1>, class=.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
